column1: # Where grofe's key layer differs from tmux/keys.tsv. `canopy grofe generate`
# emits every row of that table into conf.d/10-canopy-keys.toml, with its
# name, group and description, except as this file says.
#   command   the grofe command for that row, or - for "not bound on grofe"
#   reason    one line, carried into the generated fragment as a comment
# A name that is not in tmux/keys.tsv is an error: a stale row here would

column3: grofe re-reads every layer with its own reload, which validates them all first and applies all or nothing
